description: The frozen ReNeLLM corpus that the paper's renellm evaluations replayed. The repository ships it byte for byte at shipped_path, under its own terms (terms_file, not the repository's MIT licence): evaluation only, never training. Replay reads the site's copy when there is one, else the shipped copy, and refuses any other corpus unless SISTEER_RENELLM_NONPAPER_CORPUS_SHA names that corpus's content hash, and then labels every result non-paper.

goal_set.selection: confirmatory eval goals: HarmBench test (standard, copyright excluded) plus the stratified JailbreakBench harmful subset
goal_set.goal_id_set_sha256_of: the sorted goal ids joined by newlines (UTF-8)
